name: exists_lift_nhds
statement: C(I × A, X)} {g : I × A → E} (g_lifts : p ∘ g = f) (cont_0 : Continuous (g ⟨0, ·⟩)) (a : A) (cont_a : Continuous (g ⟨·, a⟩)) : ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 a, ∃ g' : I × A → E, ContinuousOn g' (Set.univ ×ˢ N) ∧ p ∘ g' = f ∧ (∀ a, g' (0, a) = g (0, a)) ∧ ∀ t, g' (t, a) = g (t, a)

children.body: huv ⟨hu (by rw [ht]; exact ⟨le_rfl, t_mono n.le_succ⟩), hav⟩

name: monodromy_theorem
statement: C(I, X)} (γ : γ₀.HomotopyRel γ₁ {0,1}) (Γ : I → C(I, E)) (Γ_lifts : ∀ t s, p (Γ t s) = γ (t, s)) (Γ_0 : ∀ t, Γ t 0 = Γ 0 0) (t : I) : Γ t 1 = Γ 0 1

have_tree.body: homeo.continuous_lift sep (.comp γ .prodSwap) (g := fun st ↦ Γ st.2 st.1) ?_ ?_ ?_

name: existsUnique_continuousMap_lifts
statement: C(A, X)) (a₀ : A) (e₀ : E) (he : p e₀ = f a₀) (ex : ∀ γ : C(I, A), γ 0 = a₀ → ∃ Γ : C(I, E), Γ 0 = e₀ ∧ p ∘ Γ = f.comp γ) (uniq : ∀ γ γ' : C(I, A), ∀ Γ Γ' : C(I, E), γ 0 = a₀ → γ' 0 = a₀ → Γ 0 = e₀ → Γ' 0 = e₀ → p ∘ Γ = f.comp γ → p ∘ Γ' = f.comp γ' → γ 1 = γ' 1 → Γ 1 = Γ' 1) : ∃! F : C(A, E), F a₀ = e₀ ∧ p ∘ F = f

have_tree.name: hfap
have_tree.body: by rw [← this]; exact p.map_source hep

name: exists_path_lifts
statement: ∃ Γ : C(I, E), p ∘ Γ = γ ∧ Γ 0 = e

name: liftPath_apply_one_eq_of_homotopicRel
statement: C(I, X)} (h : γ₀.HomotopicRel γ₁ {0,1}) (e : E) (h₀ : γ₀ 0 = p e) (h₁ : γ₁ 0 = p e) : cov.liftPath γ₀ e h₀ 1 = cov.liftPath γ₁ e h₁ 1

have_tree.body: cov.liftHomotopyRel (f₀' := cov.liftPath γ₀ e h₀) (f₁' := cov.liftPath γ₁ e h₁) H
